name: Coturn TURN/STUN Server
what_it_is: Coturn is a free, open-source implementation of TURN and STUN servers for VoIP and WebRTC NAT traversal. It acts as a media relay gateway, enabling peers to communicate through firewalls and NATs when direct peer-to-peer connections are not possible.
components: turnadmin — administration and user management CLI
detect-external-ip — helper binary for auto-detecting external IP in Docker environments
protocols: TURN (RFC 5766, RFC 6062, RFC 6156, RFC 7443, RFC 7635, RFC 8016)
measurement: Prometheus metrics interface (via libmicrohttpd + prometheus-client-c; not available in apt package)
Telnet CLI for live management and stats queries
configuration: min-port / max-port for UDP relay range (default 49152–65535)
TURN REST API auth (time-limited HMAC-SHA1 shared-secret, draft-uberti-behave-turn-rest-00)
external-ip / relay-ip — explicit or auto-detected (DETECT_EXTERNAL_IP env var)
User databases: SQLite, MariaDB/MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB
Multi-threading model configurable for full CPU utilisation
DNS SRV / ALTERNATE-SERVER (300) / network load-balancer for horizontal scaling
fault_injection: No built-in fault injection mechanism; network-level faults must be introduced externally (e.g., tc/iptables rules on the host)
ALTERNATE-SERVER (300) redirection can be used to simulate server unavailability and test client failover
Relay port range restriction (min-port/max-port) can simulate resource exhaustion
modes: TURN relay mode with UDP relay (RFC 5766)
TURN relay mode with TCP relay (RFC 6062)
No-auth / classic long-term credentials / TURN REST API / oAuth third-party auth
constraints: Docker performs poorly with large UDP port ranges mapped via -p; --network=host is strongly recommended for production and relay-heavy workloads
Prometheus interface is not available in the apt/distro package — requires building from source with libmicrohttpd and prometheus-client-c
RFC 5780 NAT behavior discovery requires at least two listening IP addresses of the same family
SCTP support is experimental and not suitable for production use
Windows native support available but not officially supported for production
docker_services: coturn/coturn (Docker Hub) — single-container deployment; tags: latest, alpine, debian, edge-alpine, edge-debian
Data persistence directory: /var/lib/coturn/ (tmpfs mount recommended for performance)
Config override: mount custom turnserver.conf to /etc/coturn/turnserver.conf
notable_absences: No built-in network emulation or latency/loss injection
No native dashboard or web UI (management is via telnet CLI or HTTPS API only)
No built-in clustering or state replication between instances (relies on external Redis or DNS/LB)
